Take-home kits

Rather paint at your own pace? Choose a ceramic and up to 6 paints, take it all home, then bring it back and we'll glaze and fire it for you.

  1. 1

    Place your order

    Choose your pieces and colours, then pick up or delivery.

  2. 2

    Get your kit

    Your ceramic, your paints and everything else you need, picked up from Madliena or delivered to you.

  3. 3

    Paint at home

    At the kitchen table, on the balcony, wherever you like.

  4. 4

    Bring it back

    Return your piece and the kit within 2 weeks of pickup, and we refund your deposit.

  5. 5

    Collect it

    We fire it in the kiln. It's usually ready in around 3 weeks, for pickup from the warehouse.

Choose your ceramic

At your location

€40 per person

We come to you and set everything up: pieces, paints, brushes and the table, ready to paint. Perfect for your home, your office or anywhere you'd like to host.

Enquire

The menu is adaptable for every option. Should you prefer something different, we can quote accordingly. All private events are for a minimum of 6 people.

Good to know: at Tigné Beach Club and Klay, sessions take place in the venue's public space, so you'll be painting around other customers.
